html:
The Mam are a Maya people of the western highlands of Guatemala, in Huehuetenango, Quetzaltenango and San Marcos, and of nearby Chiapas in Mexico. Mam is one of the largest Maya languages.

In 1492 the Mam had their capital at Zaculeu, near present Huehuetenango, and had lost lowland territory to the expanding K'iche' kingdom. In 1525 Gonzalo de Alvarado, brother of Pedro de Alvarado, besieged Zaculeu; after months the starving defenders under their lord Kaibil Balam surrendered. In the late 1800s many Mam were forced to work on the new coffee plantations of the Pacific slope. Their neighbours include the Chuj to the north and the Kaqchikel to the east.
